appDesc.message: 2FA Authenticator - generate secure codes in your browser. Fast, offline two-factor authentication for all your accounts.

storeDesc.message:
2FA Authenticator: Your Secure Two-Factor Authentication for Chrome
Protect your online accounts with 2FA Authenticator — the ultimate two-factor authentication extension built directly into your Chrome browser. Generate secure TOTP and HOTP codes instantly, without switching devices. 2FA Authenticator makes two-factor authentication simple, fast, and reliable for everyone.

🔐 What 2FA Authenticator Offers:
🛡️ Effortless Two-Factor Authentication
⚡ Enable 2FA Authenticator protection for all your accounts in seconds
⚡ Generate one-time passcodes (OTP) with a single click using 2FA Authenticator
⚡ Support for TOTP and HOTP protocols — the gold standard of two-factor authentication
⚡ Never worry about losing access to your 2FA Authenticator codes again

🔑 Secure Code Generation with 2FA Authenticator
🔒 Generate time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) directly in Chrome
🔒 2FA Authenticator supports all major platforms: 2FA, Facebook, Amazon, GitHub, Dropbox, and more
🔒 Each 2FA Authenticator code refreshes automatically every 30 seconds
🔒 Your two-factor authentication codes are always accurate and perfectly synced

⚡ Lightning-Fast 2FA Authenticator Access
🚀 Open 2FA Authenticator from the browser toolbar — instant access to all your codes
🚀 No need to reach for your phone — two-factor authentication is now in your browser
🚀 Copy your 2FA Authenticator code with one click and paste it into any login form
🚀 Save precious time every day with 2FA Authenticator's streamlined workflow

🔍 Easy QR Code Scanning
📷 Add new accounts to 2FA Authenticator by scanning QR codes
📷 Use your webcam or upload a screenshot — 2FA Authenticator handles both
📷 Set up two-factor authentication for a new service in under 10 seconds
📷 2FA Authenticator automatically detects and parses QR codes for seamless setup

🛡️ Privacy-First 2FA Authenticator Security
🔐 All 2FA Authenticator data is stored locally on your device
🔐 Your two-factor authentication secrets never leave your browser
🔐 No external servers, no cloud storage — 2FA Authenticator keeps everything offline
🔐 Full encryption ensures your 2FA Authenticator keys remain private and protected

📦 Backup & Restore Your 2FA Authenticator Data
💾 Export your 2FA Authenticator accounts securely for backup
💾 Restore your two-factor authentication data when switching devices or browsers
💾 Never lose access to your 2FA Authenticator codes — backup with confidence
💾 2FA Authenticator makes migration between devices simple and safe

🌐 Universal 2FA Authenticator Compatibility
🌍 2FA Authenticator works with thousands of websites and services
🌍 Compatible with any platform that supports TOTP-based two-factor authentication
🌍 Use 2FA Authenticator with 2FA, Microsoft, Twitter, LinkedIn, Binance, Coinbase, and more
🌍 Replace 2FA Authenticator, Authy, or any other 2FA Authenticator app — all inside Chrome

🎨 Clean, Intuitive 2FA Authenticator Interface
✨ 2FA Authenticator features a modern, user-friendly design
✨ Organize your two-factor authentication accounts with custom labels and icons
✨ Search through your 2FA Authenticator codes instantly — even with hundreds of accounts
✨ Dark mode and light mode support — 2FA Authenticator adapts to your preferences

🚀 How to Start with 2FA Authenticator:
📥 Step 1: Install 2FA Authenticator from the Chrome Web Store
📥 Step 2: Click the 2FA Authenticator icon in your browser toolbar
📥 Step 3: Add your first account by scanning a QR code or entering a secret key manually
📥 Step 4: Use your 2FA Authenticator codes instantly — two-factor authentication is now at your fingertips

Setting up two-factor authentication has never been easier. 2FA Authenticator guides you through every step, so even if you're new to 2FA Authenticator, you'll be protected in minutes. 💡 Why Choose Authenticator?
⭐ Instant codes — no phone required, authentication lives in your browser
⭐ Offline functionality — Authenticator generates codes without an internet connection
⭐ Top-tier security — your authentication secrets are encrypted and stored locally
⭐ Universal compatibility — Authenticator supports every TOTP-enabled service
⭐ Zero cost — powerful authentication completely free
⭐ Lightweight & fast — Authenticator uses minimal resources and never slows down Chrome
⭐ No account required — start using Authenticator immediately, no sign-up needed
⭐ Regular updates — Authenticator is constantly improved for better security and performance

🔐 Why Authentication Matters:
In today's digital world, passwords alone are not enough. Authentication adds a critical second layer of security to your accounts. With Authenticator, you generate a unique, time-sensitive code that must be entered alongside your password. Even if someone steals your password, they cannot access your account without the code from your authenticator.

Authenticator brings the power of authentication directly into Chrome, eliminating the need to carry a separate device or install a mobile app. Whether you're securing your email, social media, banking, cryptocurrency wallets, or work accounts, Authenticator provides robust protection for everything.

🏆 Authenticator vs. Other Authenticator Apps:
Unlike mobile-based apps, Authenticator lives right where you need it — in your browser. No more switching between your phone and computer. No more typing codes manually. With Authenticator, your authentication codes are just one click away.

Compared to other browser-based authenticator extensions, Authenticator stands out with its focus on security, speed, and simplicity. Every aspect of Authenticator is designed to make authentication as seamless as possible while keeping your data fully protected.

🔧 Advanced Authenticator Features:
🛠️ Support for SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 algorithms in code generation
🛠️ Customizable code refresh intervals for advanced authentication setups
🛠️ Manual entry of secret keys for services that don't provide QR codes
🛠️ Authenticator supports 6-digit and 8-digit OTP codes
🛠️ Bulk import and export for managing large numbers of accounts
🛠️ Counter-based HOTP support alongside standard TOTP authentication

📢 Trusted by Thousands of Users Worldwide
Authenticator is trusted by security-conscious individuals, developers, IT professionals, and everyday users who understand the importance of authentication. Join the growing community of users who rely on Authenticator to keep their digital lives secure.

Your security matters. Your time matters. Authenticator delivers both — powerful authentication with zero friction, zero cost, and zero compromise. Install Authenticator today and take control of your online security with the most convenient authentication solution for Chrome.

🔐 Authenticator — Authentication Made Simple, Secure, and Smart.
